description: Update a memory flagged by memory_check_freshness with corrected content after its related code changed. Replaces the stored content and refreshes the git context (current commit SHA) so future freshness checks compare against the new baseline. For a general edit to any memory that is NOT part of a freshness check, use memory_update instead.

id.description: UUID of the memory item to correct

related_paths.description: Files/dirs this memory is about (e.g. ["src/api.ts"]). Refreshes staleness tracking for future checks.

name: memory_correct
